description: Defines revocation checking policies and functions for certificate validation in Chromium's network security code.

classes.name: RevocationPolicy
classes.description: Struct defining policies for certificate revocation checks, including options for checking revocation, network access, CRL fallback, and baseline enforcement.

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Verifies the revocation status of a certificate chain according to a specified policy, adding errors if any.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a chain using a CRLSet, returning the revocation result.
